name: Concordance
instructions_text: Concordance aggregates 18 refreshed-on-schedule data sources (SEC EDGAR, FRED, World Bank, UN Comtrade, GDELT news, CourtListener, govinfo, arXiv/CORE, Hacker News, Stack Exchange, Wikipedia, weather, DefiLlama, finnhub/twelvedata/polygon quotes) into six paid tools, $0.01-$0.05 per call in USDC (Base or Solana). Every tool takes a flat JSON body; responses cite real sources, never black-box summaries. concordance_search: one-query full-text search with optional source/category/since filters. concordance_digest: one call groups a topic across every category with counts (not an LLM summary). concordance_timeline: coverage ordered oldest-first for tracking a story. concordance_corroboration: counts DISTINCT sources backing a claim - the trust signal. concordance_company_brief: quotes from 3 market providers + SEC filings + mentions for one ticker or company name; partial sections are normal. concordance_series: tabular series by source + series_id (fred GDP/CPIAUCSL/UNRATE/FEDFUNDS/DGS10; world_bank US-<indicator>). Call concordance_help for the vendor's full document.

concordance_search.description: Full-text search across every aggregated data source in one call: news, SEC filings, court opinions, academic papers, government records, and developer discussions. One query surfaces everything concordant across independently-sourced, citable results (source, category, title, content, url, published_at) -- not a single-source wrapper. Optional source/category/since filters; limit 1-100 (default 20). $0.01 per call.

concordance_series.description: Tabular time-series lookup by source + series_id: economic indicators (FRED, World Bank, UN Comtrade), crypto TVL (DefiLlama), weather (open_meteo), and stock quotes (finnhub/twelvedata/polygon). Optional start/end date range; returns [{observed_at, value}] points. $0.01 per call. Source slugs and series ids are listed in the param notes; the vendor's free /catalog endpoint has the live list.

params.source: Catalog source slug: arxiv, core, courtlistener, defillama, finnhub, gdelt, govinfo, hackernews, open_meteo, polygon, regulations_gov, sec_edgar, stackexchange, twelvedata, un_comtrade, wikipedia, world_bank, fred.
params.series_id: Vendor series id, e.g. fred: GDP, CPIAUCSL, UNRATE, FEDFUNDS, DGS10; world_bank: US-NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (<COUNTRY>-<indicator>). The vendor's free /catalog endpoint lists every live series.

params.company: Ticker (AAPL) or company name (Apple). Coverage is a bounded vendor watchlist.
